priorIterationNotes: First System2 CI exposed an over-strict generic rollover interpretation; remediation preserved prior-day offline rollover while keeping production same-day identity strict.
Second System2 CI exposed the same boundary in the new remediation test; the negative case was correctly moved to production identity mode rather than weakening runtime fail-close.

A5.priorFailure: Missing sum.rowsRead in an HTTP-200 GraphQL group was coerced to 0 and could yield known=true.
fix: Require exactly one account result and at least one analytics group.
Require group date exactly equal requested UTC quota day.
Require rowsRead and rowsWritten to be JavaScript safe nonnegative integer numbers.
Reject duplicate date+databaseId identities and aggregate overflow.
Invalid/partial groups return known=false with rowsRead/rowsWritten null.
Quota evaluator therefore returns QUOTA_BUDGET_DEFER / ACCOUNT_WIDE_D1_USAGE_UNKNOWN.
A5.freshnessPolicy: NOT_DOCUMENTED_BY_VENDOR; no freshness seconds or safety percentage invented

A6.priorFailure: Malformed same-day reservation JSON was silently skipped, making outstanding read/write reservation zero.
fix: Malformed/incomplete/ambiguous same-day rows do not disappear.
Integrity INVALID saturates outstanding write/read to 100000/5000000 as a blocking sentinel, not a usage claim.
Evaluator explicitly returns QUOTA_BUDGET_DEFER / D1_QUOTA_LEDGER_INTEGRITY_INVALID when ledger integrity is not VALID.
Production loader requires receipt identity validation before budgeting.
Production loader validates check_id, check_type, expected/observed payload, status, schema/directive/budget identity, check_timestamp and stored hash.
Current full identity hash and bounded legacy payload hash are supported; mismatch blocks.
Generic summarizer still permits legitimate prior-UTC-day rollover exclusion; production current-day SELECT treats wrong-day reservation identity as invalid.

system1Protection.rule: Do not promote 2825 or any unknown read cost into an authorized reserve.

allowed: Read-only account/D1 evidence when read headroom is proven.
Oct08 36-key / 11843-key read-only census under strict metadata/read budget guards.
Offline missing-key repair planning, conflict quarantine, PIT/immutability validation.

reverify: Replay missing/null/string/invalid GraphQL rowsRead/rowsWritten and duplicate identity cases.
Verify partial GraphQL returns known=false and cannot grant physical mutation.
Replay malformed same-day reservation/result rows and confirm explicit integrity INVALID.
Verify malformed ledger cannot yield outstanding 0 and cannot grant.
Verify legitimate UTC rollover remains supported without weakening current-day production identity.
Confirm System1 write/read reserve still false/null and no Formal Core/production/billing changes.
